top_signals.title: AstraZeneca Said to Have Explored Bristol Myers Merger
top_signals.summary: AstraZeneca Plc has explored an acquisition of Bristol Myers Squibb Co., in a megadeal that would create one of the world’s largest drugmakers, according to people familiar with the matter.
